item.text:
### (a) Social posts

1. Commercial deep-sea mining will drive hundreds of deep-sea species extinct. We will not accept irreversible destruction for minerals. We must stop this industry before it starts.

2. The deep ocean is alive, extraordinary and irreplaceable. Commercial mining will destroy fragile habitats and drive hundreds of species extinct. We are standing up to protect it.

3. We have a choice: protect the deep sea or allow mining companies to push hundreds of species into extinction. We choose protection—and we demand a halt to commercial deep-sea mining.

### (b) Newsletter opening

The deep sea is not an empty wasteland. It is a living world, home to species found nowhere else on Earth. If commercial deep-sea mining begins, it will drive hundreds of those species extinct. We refuse to accept that destruction as the price of extracting minerals from the ocean floor. Mining machines will rip through fragile habitats, stir up vast sediment clouds, and bring industrial noise and pollution into ecosystems that cannot withstand them. We are calling for a halt before this industry starts, because prevention is the only honest response. The deep ocean is alive, irreplaceable, and worth defending—and together, we intend to defend it.
